rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for an unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, with blind VST PCA, distance heatmap and library-size table used to inspect sample_01 under an explicit keep-inspect-report policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by group size; normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model; Control is set as the explicit reference with a named contrast, apeglm shrinkage, and BH at 0.05 passed to results(). Enrichment uses fgsea on the full Wald-stat ranked list against Hallmark 2026.1 with a 15-500 size window and the tested genes as universe, and the report enumerates versions, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and caveats. The only minor gap is that the design formula (~condition) is implied rather than written out.
